title: Inter's derby matters more than a 2031 stadium
caption:
Inter play Milan at San Siro tomorrow, 3:45 PM ET — and per Corriere dello Sport, five Inter players are out of it, captain Lautaro Martínez among them. Inter and AC Milan unveiled the 71,500-seat Generali Stadium on Thursday; first match is targeted for 2031/32.
